patch.value: Beat the constant baseline with item-paired recursive promotion gates

Build on PR #94 with a bounded title-feature learner, held-out item confidence intervals against incumbent and constants, and at least three measured recursive proposal attempts on the same public corpus. Preserve contamination, approvals, resource accounting, resume and cancellation. Report refusals honestly.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Pre-change diagnosis: PR #94 uses one logistic weight times a strictly positive log-title-length feature. Its greedy classifier is necessarily constant, so more samples, higher learning rate or more updates cannot make it useful. The held-out set has 36 closed and 5 other items, so always-closed scores 36/41=0.8780487805; the stochastic reward correctly penalizes uncertainty and cannot be substituted with greedy accuracy. Eight updates and 256 samples learn the majority slowly (0.5980 then 0.6810), but capacity is the primary defect. Holding every identical projected length in one partition is conservative yet prevents renamed-input leakage; retain this exact split. Proposed bounded intercept plus hashed title-word vector has no status/ID features and keeps all title-identical inputs together. Add deterministic paired bootstrap confidence intervals over held-out items against BOTH constant actions and the incumbent, in addition to existing sampled, exact-improvement and gap gates. Increase only explicit approved fit/sample allowances; retain every failed frontier and never relax the gate. Existing prefix/rsipower items cover broader chronological forecasting and transfer, distinct from this snapshot-recognition child.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Implementation in progress: bounded 64-column title-only features plus an intercept, unchanged source-action importance weighting, versioned vector checkpoint digests and full resume verification. Item-paired percentile bootstrap uses 8192 deterministic resamples, 41 held-out items rather than 40000 repeated rollouts, and Bonferroni-adjusted intervals for incumbent and both constant actions. Existing sampled confidence/effect, exact improvement and gap gates remain additional requirements. A preliminary numerical probe still trails the constant baseline; no win is claimed. Explicit sealed retry_rejected exploration will attempt three generations while keeping refused checkpoints out of collection and preserving all per-job reservations. Legacy scalar programmes keep their exact identities and stop semantics.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Three real external attempts on the same public pm-ops commit and original split are complete: n_train=105, n_held_out=41, baseline=36/41=0.8780487805. Held-out expected rewards and nominal 95% item-bootstrap CIs: g1 0.8713980699 [0.7743570291,0.9668509885], g2 0.8645003749 [0.7683455624,0.9579166612], g3 0.8534392510 [0.7593053408,0.9436312068]. All three are refused against the constant; zero promoted successors. Every collection used the unchanged seed policy; the derived learning rates were 1,0.5,0.25. The baseline still wins and no gate was weakened. Each job charged 256 optimizer updates exactly once; 3072 actions were collected. Resume verified all three, preserved checkpoint bytes, launched no new job, and status agreed. Source inventory bytes are unchanged. Execution used a PATH without Git and a plain controller tracker. Complete metrics, adjusted paired differences and full digests are in docs/baseline-frontier-evidence.json. Diagnostic log-loss fitting was worse (first score 0.7492), so it was not adopted.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Behavioural revert proof in isolated source copies: removing only the vector fit dispatch makes the three-promotion capacity regression fail (1 failed, exit 1); disabling only application of the item gate makes the improving-but-below-constant regression fail (1 failed, exit 1). Restoring both functions passes the two focused regressions (2/2, zero failures/skips). No production source was modified during the ongoing release gate.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Draft PR #95 is open against main and explicitly depends on #94. The first expanded local release attempt failed the new Git-free fixture at its unchanged 280-second child deadline under concurrent shared-host gates; that failed attempt is retained and is not passing evidence. The obsolete full run and linked snapshot run are superseded. The synthetic fixture now selects ten distinct input groups per partition and declares 512 evaluation episodes, retaining 95 percent confidence, the 0.01 effect threshold, three real jobs, all replay/budget assertions and the original deadlines. The real public experiment still uses 1024 actions and 40000 evaluation episodes. Cache each policy probability once per held-out item during action rollouts, preserving every action seed and numerical reward while removing repeated vector dot products. Final source gates and linked acceptance will rerun.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: The operational acceptance dispatcher now has in-process and Git-free coverage. A synthetic entry coordinate did not exist, so the shared launcher correctly treated it as an import and skipped execution; the test then reported missing evidence. Use the actual existing script entry path in those tests. This corrects the fixture without changing launcher semantics or production promotion logic. Source proof tests pass 3/3 after probability caching; final expanded acceptance and full gates are rerunning.

value.author: codex-agent

The behavioral frontier and all candidate checkpoint digests remain identical.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Refined verification keeps three real refusal generations in-process and uses a separate single-fit/replay acceptance with a Git-free PATH, avoiding duplicate three-job work in two test processes. The independently recorded real public run still contains three non-git generations and unchanged checkpoint/budget replay. Confidence, effect thresholds, source coverage and all deadlines are unchanged. Added real-controller negative cases require the existing gap and insufficient sampled-evidence refusals to stop even when item-refusal exploration is enabled; only verified item-gate refusals may continue. Malformed coefficient and feature payloads and a missing corpus are also covered.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: The original gap and sampled-evidence stop regressions pass through real controllers and read-only status (1/1). Bootstrap/capacity/constant-refusal focused checks pass 3/3. Bootstrap replicates now use native Float64Array numeric sorting, preserving all 8192 resamples and the exact percentile order statistics while avoiding an instrumented JavaScript comparator on every comparison. Dispatcher negative tests cover each missing coordinate. The superseded two-process three-attempt fixture retained a shared-host timeout; it is not a passing final-head receipt. Final expanded gates use one Git-free fit/replay plus the separate three-attempt in-process acceptance, with original deadlines unchanged.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Pinned tracker-linked acceptance passes 10/10 at its recorded snapshot, zero failures/skips, in 534.957 seconds. The separately added original-stop regression passes 1/1; native-bootstrap focused checks pass 3/3. Full CI exposed a fixture dependency omission: the tiny Compose image copies an explicit module list and lacked the new item-evaluation module imported by bandit. Add that module to its COPY list; production and LM Dockerfiles already copy all root TypeScript sources. Existing real Compose lifecycle tests failed before this correction and will rerun. Superseded branch CI runs are canceled or failed, not passing evidence; final-head npm/Bun gates remain required.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Additional evaluator-only diagnosis: the training partition is 77 closed and 28 other (77/105=0.7333), versus 36/41=0.8780 closed in held-out. The fixed length-group split therefore shifts class frequency by about 14.47 percentage points. Each 1024-action batch still reuses only 105 unique training inputs. All three real greedy classifiers predict closed for every held-out item and tie the constant; stochastic rewards remain below it. This strengthens the recorded frontier diagnosis rather than changing the reward, split, baseline or gate. Aggregate counts are added to the evidence receipt.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Objective redesign starts from PR 95 and incorporates the latest PR 94 head. First measure the frozen public corpus: class balance, constant predictions, class-conditional rewards and feature/target information. Preserve the original negative result. Select and seal a tracker-useful objective before running successor fits; retain paired bootstrap, contamination and resource gates, and require constant plus fixed heuristic comparisons. No merge or release is authorized.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Data-first analysis at the frozen public pm-ops commit: 146 items; old title-length split train 105 (77 closed,28 other), held-out 41 (36 closed,5 other). Always-closed predicts closed for every item: closed-class reward 1, other-class reward 0; overall 0.8780487805. Always-other reverses these and earns 0.1219512195. Held-out mean title lengths are 79.8611 closed versus 79.8 other; train 82.5325 versus 89.5. Inputs contain length plus hashed words, no timing/lifecycle information; current edited titles and snapshot status cannot support a temporal forecast. Three original rewards 0.8713980699/0.8645003749/0.8534392510 remain honest refusals. All 146 histories expose a creation title and type. Creation-title split gives train 104 (68 Issue,36 other), held-out 42 (22 Issue,20 other). Training-only word counts show usable routing information: publish appears in 15 Issue vs 1 other; npm 10 vs 0; pm 9 vs 22; ops 4 vs 13. These are associations, not independent generalization evidence.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Predeclared new objective: creation-time Issue routing from the first create-event title; target is the first create-event type equals Issue. This is intake triage, not a future-closure claim. Use stochastic balanced accuracy: half the mean correct-action probability within each class. All constant/random-input-independent predictors score exactly 0.5. Keep all 146 examples, original length-group contamination split applied to original titles, 64 title-only columns, training-only balanced collection, three bounded external attempts, 8192 paired stratified item-bootstrap replicates and the original 0.01 effect requirement. Four comparisons (incumbent, both constants, fixed keyword heuristic) use Bonferroni family confidence 95 percent. The heuristic is frozen before new fitting: whole words bug/fix/fail*/error/regression/security/refus*/reject*/corrupt*/broken/crash*. Its diagnostic balanced accuracy is 0.5988562 train and 0.6545455 held-out; it was inspected during objective diagnosis, so validation is adaptive and no independent final-test claim is warranted. No threshold, split or heuristic tuning after fits. Both classes must satisfy minimum item counts; rejected checkpoints never collect. Preserve all legacy programme identities and negative evidence.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Three predeclared real external intake attempts completed on the frozen public corpus (104 training,42 held-out; held-out classes 20 other/22 Issue). Balanced accuracy with 95 percent stratified item-bootstrap intervals: g1 0.6080315976 [0.5184090204,0.6933652525]; g2 0.5915538072 [0.5245356249,0.6579211102]; g3 0.5667374267 [0.5221832763,0.6118104112]. Either constant scores exactly 0.5 [0.5,0.5]; frozen keyword router 0.6545454545 [0.5340909091,0.7727272727]. G1/G2 fail adjusted incumbent/constant effects; G3 clears their 0.01 lower-effect bound but fails the heuristic. Zero promotions; every collector remains the seed. All three actual jobs charged 256 steps once; resume verifies three generations, byte-identical checkpoints, no additional jobs, consistent status and unchanged 300-file source inventory. No objective, threshold, split, heuristic or resource bound was tuned after fitting. Targeted legacy checks pass 6/6; full npm/Bun CI is pending.

value.text: Additional original-task feature diagnosis: the same frozen keyword flag occurs in 17/77 closed versus 9/28 other training titles, and 8/36 closed versus 2/5 other held-out titles. It is not a closed-status indicator; title semantics describe the work, while snapshot status reflects work completion. Public source visibility and MIT licence were verified independently. The new target instead uses the creator's intake type; the fixed heuristic is stronger than all measured new candidates. Typecheck, build, test-build, lint excluding retained ignored runtime snapshots, docstrings (50 sources,344 declarations), zero duplication and identity audit pass. Full release validation remains delegated to unchanged npm/Bun CI as requested.
